title: Existence of a flat stage in a filtered colimit
statement: Intermediate theorem used in the decomposition of lem-weil-pbc-colimit-flat-ring-map.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat, algebra.tex line 47331), part (3), applied to the system $(R_\lambda\to S_\lambda,M_\lambda)=(B_i\to C_i,C_i)_{i\ge0}$; this is the algebra result stated in the proof of Limits, Lemma Tag 04AI (lemma-descend-flat-finite-presentation, limits.tex line 1868), second paragraph

proof.text: Use tensor cancellation to identify the base-changed ring map with a base change of φ₀. Algebra.FinitePresentation.baseChange and Algebra.FinitePresentation.equiv give finite presentation of this map (the proved private helper finitePresentation_lTensor).

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-finite-presentation-model] to the flat finitely presented limit map to obtain P,Q and the compatible isomorphism. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-model-stage] to descend its comparison isomorphism to some i ≥ i₀. The latter result uses no flatness assumption.

The map Bᵢ → Bᵢ ⊗_P Q is flat by Module.Flat.baseChange applied to the flat model P → Q. Compose with the descended ring isomorphism eᵢ using RingHom.Flat.of_bijective and RingHom.Flat.comp. Rewrite with its compatibility equality to obtain flatness of the original stage map, and return this index.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Tag 02JO; split of the existing stage-existence proof into a flat model and descent of its comparison isomorphism.
